audit_scope.title: 旧v1.3 §9.2 signal routing nine-condition audit
audit_scope.scope_limit: Only the exact nine table rows (physical lines 625–633) are compared. No whole-source closure, signal registry completeness, runtime routing, or stage completion claim.

selection_and_exclusion.selection_rule: Select consecutive queue rows that are condition + unresolved + primary_residual + unresolved_for_closure_work + zero existing exact individual audit refs. Lines 625–633 are the coherent §9.2 typed signal-routing table subset.

selected_queue_rows.source_text: | `production_incident` / `hotfix_required` / `regression_prod` | Incident | production境界とapprovalを検証する |
| `feature_addition` / `scope_extension` | Add-feature | current styleのForwardへ再合流する |
| `pair_agent_tdd` / `pair-agent-tdd` / `pair-agent TDD route` / `pair programming` | Add-feature | pair cellを実行形態として選べるがstyleにしない |
| `user_feedback_iteration` / `requirement_continuous_refinement` | selected-style change intake | styleを自動変更せず、lifecycleと影響でRedesign／Add-feature／Scrum sliceへrouteする |
| `requirement_undefined` / `feasibility_unknown` / `success_condition_unclear` / `design_uncertain` | Discovery／PoC | Scrum非内包のcase-driven modelとして起動する |
| `tech_decision_required` / `option_comparison_needed` / `adr_required` | Research | 実現性実験が必要ならDiscovery／PoCへ切り替える |
| `interrupt` | subtype分岐 | 暴走はRecovery、未確定はDiscovery／PoC、追加はAdd-feature、層内gapはForwardへrouteする |

conditions.retained: 開発中のagent逸脱・暴走・context切れをRecoveryへ分岐し、中断工程へ戻す。source alias `runaway` を `agent_runaway` に正規化する一方向規則もsourceが明示する。
conditions.meaning_delta: Fixed OS Recovery type preserves the interrupted-stage return. Adopted HELIXOS-L2-040 adds a bounded retry-limit case: route to an existing Recovery or Backflow ticket with lineage, with Recovery for deviation/context loss. It is near evidence for the destination, not for the v1.3 signal set.
conditions.numeric_and_exception_boundary: 5 literal signals: agent_runaway, context_exhaustion, regression_dev, runaway, forced_stop。`runaway`だけを`agent_runaway`へ正規化する。本番regression/incidentはRecoveryではない。
conditions.counterexample: `runaway` aliasを新しいworkflow identityとして維持する、または`regression_prod`をRecoveryに流す。
conditions.residual: The five literal signals, `runaway`→`agent_runaway` normalization, development/production distinction (especially `regression_prod`), and exact signal-to-Recovery receipt remain unverified. HELIXOS-L2-040 only covers a retry-limit condition and does not establish these literal/operational boundaries.
later_decision_refs: HELIXOS-L2-040 / MPR-RC-HELIXOS-L2-040-001 (adopted exact L2/L11 pair; see later_decisions.bounded_near_comparisons[0])

conditions.retained: production incident/hotfix/regressionはIncidentへ分け、L12運用評価へ戻し、恒久対策をReverse経由へする。緊急hotfix成功を恒久修復完了にしない。
conditions.meaning_delta: 現行HXT acceptanceはIncident ticket目的、突発発行、L12/Reverse convergenceを確認するが、各旧signal名を含むtargeting例やapproval evidence検査をこの条件単位で固定していない。
conditions.numeric_and_exception_boundary: 3 literal signals: production_incident, hotfix_required, regression_prod。production境界と既存approval条件は要るが、signal自体はapprovalを生成しない。
conditions.counterexample: production triggerをRecoveryへ分類する、または`hotfix_required`を本番変更の承認と見なす。
conditions.residual: 各aliasとenv=prod/approval snapshot/Incident routeの同一revision receipt、およびtemporary containmentと恒久Reverseの分離oracle。

conditions.retained: 既存style内の機能/範囲追加をAdd-featureへ送り、Forward該当層へ戻す。選択済み開発styleはsignalだけで変えない。
conditions.meaning_delta: 現在はAdd-feature workflowと`add-design`/`add-impl` PLAN kind、development styleを別axisに置く。単一のgeneric routeではなく、影響layerに収束する。
conditions.numeric_and_exception_boundary: 2 trigger literals: feature_addition, scope_extension。外部約束/要求/受入意味変更ならRedesign/Decideの境界を評価する。
conditions.counterexample: feature/scope signalからstyleをProduction Scrumへ自動変更する、またはAdd-featureを独立style/kindとする。
conditions.residual: trigger alias、変更impact判定、選択style内のForward target layerまでのexact route/evidence oracle。

conditions.retained: pair-agent TDDはpair cellの実行形態として選択でき、development styleではない。Route targetはAdd-featureで選択styleのForwardへ合流する。
conditions.meaning_delta: HARNESS fixed pairはstyleとticket種類を分離し、OS pairはAdd-featureの差分追加を定義する。旧sourceのpair-agent aliasはcurrent canonical identityとして直接再出力せず、現行pair workflow/worker構成と同一だと推定しない。
conditions.numeric_and_exception_boundary: 4 alias spellings: pair_agent_tdd, pair-agent-tdd, pair-agent TDD route, pair programming。これらは別style enumを増やさない。
conditions.counterexample: pair programmingを新development styleにする、または実行形態だけでAdd-featureのscope/Forward impactを省く。
conditions.residual: 旧aliasのcompatibility mapping、pair implementation cellの対象とowner、既存style内Add-feature ticketへの明示接続をこのcondition-specific acceptanceで確かめること。

conditions.retained: 将来版へ回した項目は消さず保全し、導入可能時にDecideを経てAdd-featureとしてForwardへ入れる。
conditions.meaning_delta: 旧 `future activation` はcurrent ticket descriptionで`later version`/version-upとして表現され、特定の現行release/version値は決めない。新しいkindを作るのではなく、保全中の既存PLANにversion_targetを持たせる別の現在契約がある。
conditions.numeric_and_exception_boundary: 1 trigger: version_deferral。future itemはactivation/Decide前にproduction Add-featureへ流さない。
conditions.counterexample: parked itemを消す、またはDecideを経ずcurrent releaseへAdd-featureする。
conditions.residual: future target/trigger、保全記録、再確認/activation decision、選択したForward layerを特定revisionに結ぶ証拠。

conditions.retained: `user_feedback_iteration`／`requirement_continuous_refinement`はstyle自動変更を起こさないchange intakeとして扱い、既存OS L2-005のsource/scope付き改善候補登録・還流を保持する。feedback lifecycleのintake/classify/ack/pending/resolution区別とsource/evidence保持は既採択HELIXOS-L2-007の責務。
conditions.meaning_delta: Adopted HELIXOS-L2-048 connects returned or verification-failed feedback using finding identity, target revision/HEAD/scope, reason, missing inputs/oracle, and origin; unresolved state remains under existing L2-007 lifecycle; LABO assesses evidence-backed candidates and OS owns issue/reissue. This is a bounded handoff/assessment connection, not a legacy-alias route selector.
conditions.numeric_and_exception_boundary: 2 legacy feedback aliases; 3 candidate change routes (Redesign / Add-feature / Scrum slice). Style is not auto-switched from a signal. L2-044 only rejects prose-only resolution evidence; L2-048 retains identity/revision/reason/origin and unresolved/evaluation/reissue connections but does not pick among the three routes.
conditions.counterexample: feedback aliasだけでstyleや3 routeを自動選択する、またはprose-only handoverでfindingをresolvedにする。
conditions.residual: Legacy alias-to-route compatibility, impact/requirements-authority oracle selecting among Redesign/Add-feature/Scrum slice, and receipt binding the chosen route to accepted style and target requirements revision. L2-048 does not close the three-route selector; existing L2-007 lifecycle/evidence duties are retained context, not an unowned residual.

conditions.retained: 要件/成功条件の欠落や成立性不明はScrum phaseに混ぜずcase-driven DiscoveryまたはPoCとして扱い、結果をBackflow/Decideまたは発行元へ返す。画面有無によりPrototypeとPoCは別々に判定する。
conditions.meaning_delta: current pair distinguishes Discovery (unclear scope or in-development verification), PoC (technical feasibility unknown even without UI), and Prototype (UI interaction only). The legacy single table cell names Discovery/PoC as a routing pair and does not encode every current applicability branch.
conditions.numeric_and_exception_boundary: 4 trigger aliases: requirement_undefined, feasibility_unknown, success_condition_unclear, design_uncertain. Discovery vs PoC are separate current targets; no-screen excludes Prototype, not PoC. Scrum does not subsume either case-driven model.
conditions.counterexample: screenless PoCを省く、screenless Prototypeを強制する、またはDiscovery/PoCをproduction Scrum phaseにする。
conditions.residual: signal-specific selection of Discovery vs PoC, trigger lifecycle (planning vs interruption), source/return ticket, and decision gate to the exact requirements revision.

conditions.retained: technical choice/comparison/ADR intake uses Research to gather references, not decide; where feasibility experiment is needed it switches to Discovery/PoC. Decide owns selection, with accepted result routed to Forward.
conditions.meaning_delta: Fixed HARNESS L2 names the same three research signals, preserves reference-only role, and distinguishes research from selection. OS fixed HXT tests Research purpose and Forward/requester connection but does not specify every trigger string or research-to-Discovery switch in its HXT row.
conditions.numeric_and_exception_boundary: 3 trigger aliases: tech_decision_required, option_comparison_needed, adr_required. 1 exception: if feasibility experiment is required, route to Discovery/PoC instead; Research itself does not select.
conditions.counterexample: Research output is treated as selected technology, or an actual feasibility experiment remains in desk Research without switching.
conditions.residual: decision criteria, requester identity, experiment-needed oracle, and route/result receipt across Research→Discovery/PoC→Decide/Forward.

conditions.retained: `interrupt` is subtype-dispatched to Recovery, Discovery/PoC, Add-feature, or a layer-local Forward gap. Current ticket types have distinct purpose, initiation, and convergence instead of one interrupt type.
conditions.meaning_delta: Adopted HELIXOS-L2-040 gives a bounded retry-limit case: existing Recovery/Backflow ticket type and destination are used, while a reason requiring another route is not guessed and returns to the existing OS-010 owner. This is adjacent unknown/reason handling, not a general interrupt resolver.
conditions.numeric_and_exception_boundary: 1 interrupt parent signal with 4 outcome routes: runaway→Recovery, uncertainty→Discovery/PoC, addition→Add-feature, layer gap→Forward. Unknown subtype has no asserted default route.
conditions.counterexample: route every interrupt to Recovery, or treat unresolved subtype as a safe success/Full V fallback.
conditions.residual: All four legacy subtype mappings, typed interrupt input, ambiguity policy, and route receipt remain residual. HELIXOS-L2-040 covers only retry-ceiling routing and does not choose Recovery/Discovery-PoC/Add-feature/Forward for every interrupt or set a default for unknown subtype.
